notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
It’s been just over a week since launch, and we’re thrilled to see so many of you enjoying the game. Now that things have settled, we’ve put together a major patch that tackles the issues you’ve reported and builds on what we’ve learned. We hope you like these improvements—and don’t forget to pay off your debt on time!

- Removed: Old voice line
- Fixed: Radio sound bug
- Fixed: Soft‑lock in tutorial
- Fixed: Game soft‑lock on loss
- Fixed: Death animation for the hacker
- Fixed: Van map syncing
- Fixed: Save files not being removed correctly
- Improved: Van item box functionality
- Improved: Lighting when the flashlight is turned off
- Added: Steam avatar and username display above players in the van lobby
- Added: Additional levels to the introduction debt
- Added: New voice lines and visual effects to remind you when it’s time to pay the debt
- Added: Option to skip the introduction debt
- Updated: Curtain‑van ghost event now triggers only on debt level 4 and above
- Updated: Introduction debt duration reduced to 1 day
- Updated: Death penalty changed to lose 25% of that night’s earnings
- Updated: Login screen font
- Updated: Frequency of computer shutdown events decreased

notes.title: Thank you for the support!
notes.content:
[h2]We are in the Summer Sale - 20% off![/h2][p][i]So no new news, but still exciting![/i][/p][p]The discount will however only be available till [b]8 July[/b], so don't wait and [b]bring a friend[/b]. 
You can't play without a partner in crime 🤝[/p][p][/p][h2]Thank you - the game now works![/h2][p]We also want to thank people for [b]giving reviews[/b] and for helping out finding our most critical bugs! [/p][p]We are really sorry for the inconvenience of:[/p][list][*][p](fixed ✅) Crouching through the floor / ceiling (?) making you stuck in the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p](fixed ✅) Stuck on day one by forever-loading[/p][/*][/list][p]But thanks to people reporting these issues through our bug report or by joining the Discord, we were able to faster locate the issues and we really appreciate that. We of course anticipated issues, even though we've play tested, but not these big issues - so we are grateful for you patience and feedback![/p][p][/p][p]With that said, we are continuing gathering your thoughts and working on them during the sale, so don't miss out! [/p][p][/p][h3]If you encounter any issues or have thoughts, tell us in:[/h3][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc3wbBba9T7AdSTXxqEh4mxNyUsVZG4yKwgvxxYWkrFNW11QQ/viewform" style="button" buttoncolor="#262626"]Bug report [/url]  [url="https://discord.gg/yAWqjV2jeh" style="button" buttoncolor="#262626"]Discord[/url]  [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3223330/discussions/" style="button" buttoncolor="#262626"]Steam Community[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]And we will always value your reviews - thank you again![/h3][p][i]Throwback to some demo reviews:[/i][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276366/f845948f9ea0f3485dab96617e607fea45c972e1.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p]//the devs downstairs[/p]

notes.title: Find or be Found - Out NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]📢Find or be Found is out!📢[/h1][p]We’re BEYOND EXCITED to say that Find or be Found is available for everyone to play starting TODAY! And with it, we have a 20% discount![/p][p]This discount will go on into Steam Summer sale as well, so poke friends during this period also to make them play with you 🌼[/p][p][/p][h3]We appreciate all the support, and if you enjoy the game leave a review✍️[/h3][p]If you have more specific feedback and want to talk to us about how to improve the experience, join the Discord or do a post in our community hub here on Steam! [/p][p][/p][h2]The future[/h2][p]We are now looking ahead to push a few patches and updates we couldn't make to release, more on that later next month![/p][p]We also want to thank all ~2000 people so much for playing the demo, we got both people joining the discord to share some thoughts, and in the reviews of the demo page. Some things we heard and want to implement more is:[/p][list][*][p][b]Balancing[/b] - between the different difficulties of paying your debt[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clarity[/b] - this can be applied a little bit of everywhere, but we want to focus on the crucial moments such as the ghost and other life-losing events[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimizing[/b] - we've noticed even ourselves that the framerate isn't always were we want it to be, and we will look into it more[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Looking back[/h2][p]This is our first official rodeo, so every step for us has been a step into the unknown of how the results, the responds and how the support would look like. Doesn't matter if you saw this game yesterday or been around since the itch prototype (consider this chapter 2 haha) - we thank you for sticking around and showing your support!
[/p][p]The game has been through a lot of ups and downs in both the vision and team, but we've received so much support in the different stages, so we knew we had to build it further. The past 10 months has been exciting but a lot, we have known that this summer is our internal deadline, and with that knowledge we also needed to re-scope the game from time to time. We knew that to create a game is it's own difficultly, but to also release it with no funding, that is a whole other thing haha!
[/p][p][b]We the team, are however super happy with what we've been putting our hearts and hours into, and we hope you find your happy moments in our game as well🤗[/b]

Talk soon! Enjoy the game! If any questions don't hesitate to reach out to us through our contact mail or Discord![/p][p][/p][p]//Happy and grateful devs downstairs[/p]

notes.title: BIG NEWS: Demo is live! Grab a friend and play today🔦👩‍💻
notes.content:
[h1]Find or be Found Demo is Live![/h1]
We're super stoked to share the newest version of the game, much thanks to the playtests and feedback we have received. Important to think about is that the game is not yet done, so if you have more [b]thoughts and feedback[/b], share them in the [b]Steam community[/b] or on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/yAWqjV2jeh]discord[/url]![/b]

[h2]What's in the demo?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Co-op gameplay, as hacker or robber (as always)
[*] The first two difficulties with a debt payment system
[*] Gadgets to buy such as camera or scanner + more
[*] many many items to find, and many many situations to die in 😈
[/list]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3713700/Find_or_be_Found_Demo/]Download the demo now[/url][/b] and let us know what you think - [b]leave a review[/b] to help us out!

We will also during the week have a looping broadcast of a pre-recorded gaming session of two devs - so check out the pros play 👏

Thank you for sticking with us and playing the demo, join us on social media to see more of the progress 🔗⬇️

//Happy devs downstairs

notes.title: Playtest available for sign up!
notes.content:
[h1]Playtest time! [/h1]
[h2]Sign up right now with a friend on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3223330/Find_or_be_Found/]Steam[/url] 🗣️🔦[/h2]

Before we release anything major, we want to see if we can get some more player feedback by a playtest on Steam! This will likely be in [b]January[/b]*, but we want to gather as much sign-ups as we can until then.
*[i]We'll notify specific date later[/i] 🙏

[b]The playtests goal is to:[/b]
[list]
[*] 👥Test online co-op (you need a friend to sign up as well!)
[*] 🪳Finding critical bugs
[*] 🎮Test basic mechanics
[*] 📃Hear feedback through [url=https://discord.gg/yAWqjV2jeh]Discord [/url] & forms
[*] 📸And potentially see some reactions!
[/list]
I will probably repeat this when the time comes, but - the playtest is not a full representation of how the game will look or feel, we just want to see early reactions and thoughts! 💡😊

Hope to hear from you soon, otherwise we wish you happy holidays!
//The studio Downstairs 🚪
